topic: ProPublica's leaked IRS files showed Jeff Bezos paid $0 federal income tax in 2007 and 2011 and Elon Musk paid $0 in 2018 -- not by cheating, but because they hold shares rather than take income and borrow against those shares instead of selling, and the gain resets when the assets pass to heirs
title: He Made Billions And Paid Zero Tax
description:
Leaked IRS records reported by ProPublica showed Jeff Bezos paid no federal income tax in 2007 and again in 2011, and Elon Musk paid none in 2018. The trick isn't hiding money -- it's never having income: hold the shares, borrow against them, and a loan isn't income. The 25 richest Americans gained about $400 billion between 2014 and 2018 and paid roughly $13 billion in income tax, a 3.4% rate.
